sw.L: Nami nitayashika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} daima, milele na milele.
sw.B: Nitayashika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} siku zote, kwa wakati wote ujao.
sw.R: Nitayatii mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kila siku, milele na milele.

decisions.reason: As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: forever and ever: for all time
decisions.reason: Two words for lasting time are put together for emphasis (9:6; 45:18).

records.literal_gloss: And I will walk about in the broad [place], for your precepts I have sought.

en.L: And I will walk about in a wide place, for I have sought {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: I will walk where there is room and freedom, because I have searched for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: I will walk around free, because I have looked hard for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Et je marcherai au large, car j’ai recherché {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Je marcherai là où il y a de l’espace et de la liberté, car j’ai cherché {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Je pourrai aller et venir librement, parce que j’ai cherché de tout cœur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Nami nitatembea mahali penye nafasi, kwa maana nimeyatafuta maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Nitatembea mahali penye nafasi na uhuru, kwa sababu nimeyatafuta maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Nitatembea nikiwa huru, kwa sababu nimeyatafuta sana maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: A broad place is the opposite of being hemmed in by enemies and trouble (18:20; 31:9).
As in 119:2.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.
Balanced and Readable say what the picture means.

source.text: וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה בְ֭עֵדֹתֶיךָ נֶ֥גֶד מְלָכִ֗ים וְלֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will speak of your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.

en.L: And I will speak of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies before kings, and I will not be put to shame.
en.B: I will talk about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees in front of kings and not be put to shame.
en.R: I will tell kings about what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared, and I will not be ashamed.

fr.L: Et je parlerai de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages devant des rois, et je ne serai pas couvert de honte.
fr.B: Je parlerai de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets devant les rois sans être couvert de honte.
fr.R: Je parlerai aux rois de ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré, et je n’aurai pas honte.

sw.L: Nami nitazinena shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} mbele ya wafalme, wala sitaaibishwa.
sw.B: Nitazizungumzia shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} mbele ya wafalme bila kuaibishwa.
sw.R: Nitawaambia wafalme habari za shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, wala sitaona aibu.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.
As in 119:6.

records.literal_gloss: And I will delight myself in your commands, which I love.

en.L: And I will delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, which I love.
en.B: I will find my joy in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, because I love them.
en.R: I enjoy {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, because I love them.

fr.L: Et je trouverai mes délices dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements, que j’aime.
fr.B: Je trouverai ma joie dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements, car je les aime.
fr.R: Tes commandements me rendent heureux, parce que je les aime.

sw.L: Nami nitajifurahisha katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ambazo ninazipenda.
sw.B: Nitapata furaha yangu katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kwa sababu ninazipenda.
sw.R: Ninazifurahia amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kwa sababu ninazipenda.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: וְאֶשָּֽׂא־כַפַּ֗י אֶֽל־מִ֭צְוֺתֶיךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אָהָ֗בְתִּי וְאָשִׂ֥יחָה בְחֻקֶּֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will lift up my palms to your commands, which I love, and I will meditate on your statutes.

en.L: And I will lift up my palms to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, which I love, and I will meditate on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: I will raise my hands toward {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, which I love, and I will ponder {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: I will lift my hands to honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands, because I love them. And I will think deeply about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Et je lèverai mes paumes vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements, que j’aime, et je méditerai sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Je lèverai les mains vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements, que j’aime, et je méditerai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Je lèverai les mains pour honorer {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements, parce que je les aime. Et je réfléchirai profondément à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Nami nitainua viganja vyangu kwa amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ambazo ninazipenda, nami nitazitafakari kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nitainua mikono yangu kuelekea amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ambazo ninazipenda, nami nitazitafakari kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Nitainua mikono yangu kuziheshimu amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kwa sababu ninazipenda. Tena nitazifikiria sana kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.choice: lift up my palms: a gesture of prayer and reverence
decisions.reason: Lifting the hands was the posture of prayer (28:2; 141:2). Here it shows reverence for God's commands, which come from him.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
Readable says what the gesture means.

records.literal_gloss: Remember [the] word to your servant, on which you have made me hope.

en.L: Remember the word to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, on which {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me hope.
en.B: Keep in mind the word {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have made me hope in it.
en.R: Remember the word {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} gave me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant. You gave me hope through it.

fr.L: Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de la parole à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, sur laquelle {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait espérer.
fr.B: N’oublie pas la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as donnée à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait espérer en elle.
fr.R: Souviens-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de la parole que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as donnée, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur. Par elle, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as donné de l’espoir.

sw.L: Likumbuke neno kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, ambalo kwalo umenifanya nitumaini.
sw.B: Ulikumbuke neno ulilompa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; umenipa tumaini kwa neno hilo.
sw.R: Ulikumbuke neno ulilonipa mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}. Umenipa tumaini kupitia neno hilo.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter zayin, the seventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). Three of them (verses 49, 52, 55) begin with the verb "remember".

decisions.choice: remember: keep in mind and act on
decisions.reason: When God remembers (zakar), he acts on what he has said (Genesis 8:1; Exodus 2:24).
As in 119:9.
The verb is the one in verse 43, here in a form that means "cause to hope".

source.text: זֹ֣את נֶחָמָתִ֣י בְעָנְיִ֑י כִּ֖י אִמְרָתְךָ֣ חִיָּֽתְנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] my comfort in my affliction, that your saying has given me life.

en.L: This [is] my comfort in my affliction, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying has given me life.
en.B: Here is my comfort when I am brought low: {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise has kept me alive.
en.R: When I am suffering, I find comfort in this: {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise keeps me alive.

fr.L: Ceci [est] ma consolation dans mon affliction : que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos m’a fait vivre.
fr.B: Voici ce qui me console quand je suis abattu : {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse m’a gardé en vie.
fr.R: Quand je souffre, je trouve du réconfort en ceci : {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse me garde en vie.

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] faraja yangu katika mateso yangu, kwamba kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imenihuisha.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo faraja yangu ninaposhushwa chini: kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} imenihuisha.
sw.R: Ninapoteseka, ninapata faraja katika jambo hili: kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} inaniweka hai.

decisions.reason: The word ('oni) is hardship and humiliation, from the verb used in verses 67, 71 and 75.

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise
give me life: keep me alive, renew my life

source.text: זֵ֭דִים הֱלִיצֻ֣נִי עַד־מְאֹ֑ד מִ֝תּֽוֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א נָטִֽיתִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] arrogant have mocked me up to muchness; from your instruction I have not turned aside.

en.L: The arrogant have mocked me utterly; from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction I have not turned aside.
en.B: The proud have heaped scorn on me without limit, yet I have not swerved from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Proud people laugh at me without mercy, but I have not turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Les orgueilleux se sont moqués de moi à l’extrême ; de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi je ne me suis pas détourné.
fr.B: Les orgueilleux m’ont couvert de mépris sans mesure, mais je ne me suis pas écarté de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux se moquent de moi sans pitié, mais je ne me suis pas détourné de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenidhihaki kupita kiasi; kutoka mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sikugeuka.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi wamenirundikia dharau bila kikomo, lakini sijayaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi wananicheka bila huruma, lakini sijayaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The verb (helits) is related to the word for the mocker in 1:1.
As in 119:8.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: I have remembered your judgments from of old, YHWH, and I have comforted myself.

en.L: I remember {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments from of old, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I take comfort.
en.B: I call to mind {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings from long ago, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I find comfort.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I remember the decisions {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} made long ago, and they comfort me.

fr.L: Je me souviens de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements d’autrefois, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je me console.
fr.B: Je me rappelle {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions des temps anciens, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et j’y trouve du réconfort.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je me souviens des décisions que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prises il y a longtemps, et elles me consolent.

sw.L: Ninazikumbuka hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za tangu zamani, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami ninafarijika.
sw.B: Ninazikumbuka hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za zamani, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami ninapata faraja.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninazikumbuka hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ulizozitoa zamani, nazo zinanifariji.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: from of old: given long ago
decisions.reason: The word ('olam) is time beyond memory. God's rulings were given long ago and have stood ever since.
The verb (hitnachem) is to find comfort for oneself.

records.literal_gloss: Burning rage has seized me because of [the] wicked, [who] forsake your instruction.

en.L: Burning anger has seized me because of the wicked, who forsake {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Because of the wicked, who have abandoned {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction, a hot anger takes hold of me.
en.R: I am filled with anger because of wicked people who turn their backs on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Une colère brûlante m’a saisi à cause des méchants, qui abandonnent {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: À cause des méchants, qui ont abandonné {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction, une colère ardente s’empare de moi.
fr.R: Je suis rempli de colère à cause des méchants qui tournent le dos à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Hasira kali imenishika kwa sababu ya waovu, wanaoyaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya waovu, walioyaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, hasira kali inanishika.
sw.R: Nimejaa hasira kwa sababu ya watu waovu wanaoyapa kisogo mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The word (zal'afah) is a burning heat, used of the scorching wind in 11:6. Here it is the psalmist's anger, or horror, at people who abandon God's instruction.
The verb ('azav) is the one in verse 8.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: Songs have been to me your statutes in [the] house of my sojournings.

en.L: Songs {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes have been to me, in the house of my sojourning.
en.B: Your statutes have become my songs in every place where I live as a foreigner.
en.R: Wherever I live as a stranger, I sing about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Tes prescriptions ont été pour moi des chants, dans la maison où je séjourne en étranger.
fr.B: Tes prescriptions sont devenues mes chants en tout lieu où je vis en étranger.
fr.R: Partout où je vis en étranger, je chante {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Nyimbo zimekuwa kwangu kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, katika nyumba ya ugeni wangu.
sw.B: Kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zimekuwa nyimbo zangu kila mahali ninapoishi kama mgeni.
sw.R: Popote ninapoishi kama mgeni, ninaimba juu ya kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.reason: The word (zemirot) is used of songs with instruments (95:2).

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

decisions.choice: the house of my sojourning: wherever I live as a foreigner
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself a sojourner (verse 19); the house of his sojourning is his life on earth, lived as a foreigner who is only passing through (39:13).

decisions.choice: every place where I live as a foreigner (B); wherever I live as a stranger (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means.

source.text: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I have remembered in the night your name, YHWH, and I have kept your instruction.

en.L: I remember in the night {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Through the night I think of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at night I think about who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, and I obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Je me souviens dans la nuit de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je garde {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Pendant la nuit je pense à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la nuit, je pense à qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es, et j’obéis à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Ninalikumbuka usiku jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nayashika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Usiku kucha ninalifikiria jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami ninashikamana na mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiku ninafikiria jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo, nami ninayatii mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.choice: your name: God himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: A name stood for the person and what he had shown himself to be (5:12; 20:2).
As in 119:1.
The verb is past in form; it describes what the psalmist has done and still does, so it is rendered with the present, like "remember".
Readable says what the name stands for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: This has been to me, that your precepts I have kept.

en.L: This has been mine: that I have kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: This has been my part in life: I have held to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: This is how I have lived: I have obeyed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Ceci a été pour moi : que j’ai gardé {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Voilà quelle a été ma part dans la vie : je me suis attaché à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Voici comment j’ai vécu : j’ai obéi à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Hili limekuwa langu: kwamba nimeyashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Hili limekuwa fungu langu maishani: nimeyashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo nilivyoishi: nimeyatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.choice: this has been mine: this is what I have
alternatives: this has happened to me because I kept your precepts
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and can be read two ways: keeping God's precepts is what the psalmist has as his own (as "my portion" in verse 57), or the comfort of verses 52-55 came to him because he kept them.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.
As in 119:2.

records.literal_gloss: My portion [is] YHWH; I have said to keep your words.

en.L: My portion [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I have said [that I would] keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my share in life; I have said that I will hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is all I need. I have promised to obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.

fr.L: Ma part, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’ai dit [que je] garderais {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est ma part dans la vie ; j’ai dit que je m’attacherais à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est tout ce dont j’ai besoin. J’ai promis d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.

sw.L: Fungu langu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nimesema [kwamba nitayashika] maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye fungu langu maishani; nimesema kwamba nitayashika maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye kila kitu ninachohitaji. Nimeahidi kuyatii maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter heth, the eighth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).

decisions.choice: my portion: my share, what I have
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi received no land, for the LORD was its portion (Numbers 18:20). The psalmist says the same of himself (16:5; 73:26).

alternatives: My portion, LORD, I have said, is to keep your words
decisions.reason: The name may be the subject ("the LORD is my portion") or a call to God ("my portion, LORD, ..."). The psalm otherwise speaks to God, but the first reading is the plainer.

decisions.choice: I have said: I have promised
decisions.reason: To say that one will do something is to promise it.
As in 119:9; here the word is plural.
Readable says what the picture means.

records.literal_gloss: I have entreated your face with all [the] heart; be gracious to me according to your saying.

en.L: I have entreated {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face with all [the] heart; be gracious to me according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying.
en.B: With my whole heart I have pleaded for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} favor; show me kindness, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise said.
en.R: I have begged {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart to be kind to me. Show me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kindness, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise said.

fr.L: J’ai imploré {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face de tout cœur ; fais-moi grâce selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos.
fr.B: De tout mon cœur j’ai supplié pour obtenir {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} faveur ; montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse l’a dit.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai supplié de tout mon cœur d’être bon pour moi. Montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse l’a dit.

sw.L: Nimeusihi uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa moyo wote; unifadhili kulingana na kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa moyo wangu wote nimeomba kibali {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}; unionyeshe wema, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilivyosema.
sw.R: Nimekusihi kwa moyo wangu wote unionee huruma. Unionyeshe wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilivyosema.

decisions.choice: entreat your face: plead for your favor
decisions.reason: The phrase (chillah panim) is to soften someone's face, to seek favor from a ruler or from God (Exodus 32:11).
The verb (chanan) is to show kindness that is not owed.

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

records.literal_gloss: I have thought about my ways, and I have turned my feet to your testimonies.

en.L: I have considered my ways, and I have turned my feet to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies.
en.B: I have thought hard about how I live, and turned my steps back to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees.
en.R: I thought about the way I was living, and I turned back to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: J’ai considéré mes voies, et j’ai tourné mes pieds vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages.
fr.B: J’ai bien réfléchi à ma façon de vivre, et j’ai ramené mes pas vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets.
fr.R: J’ai réfléchi à la façon dont je vivais, et je suis revenu faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Nimezifikiria njia zangu, nami nimeigeuza miguu yangu kwenye shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nimeufikiria sana mwenendo wangu, nikazirudisha hatua zangu kwenye shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Nilifikiria jinsi nilivyokuwa nikiishi, nikarudi kufanya yale ambayo shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zinasema.

decisions.reason: Turning the feet is a picture of turning back to God, of repentance.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.
Balanced and Readable bring out that this is a turning back.

records.literal_gloss: I have hurried and not delayed to keep your commands.

en.L: I have hurried and not delayed to keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: Quickly, without waiting, I set myself to keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: I hurry to obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands. I do not wait.

fr.L: Je me suis hâté et je n’ai pas tardé à garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Vite, sans attendre, je me suis mis à garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Je me dépêche d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements. Je n’attends pas.

sw.L: Nimefanya haraka wala sikukawia kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Kwa haraka, bila kungoja, ninajitahidi kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ninafanya haraka kuzitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Sikawii.

decisions.reason: The verb (hitmahmah) is to linger or hold back (Genesis 19:16).

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] cords of [the] wicked have surrounded me; your instruction I have not forgotten.

en.L: The ropes of the wicked have wrapped around me; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction I have not forgotten.
en.B: The wicked have tangled me in their ropes, but I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Wicked people have tried to trap me, but I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Les cordes des méchants m’ont enlacé ; je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Les méchants m’ont empêtré dans leurs cordes, mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Les méchants ont essayé de me prendre au piège, mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Kamba za waovu zimenizunguka; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sijayasahau.
sw.B: Waovu wamenitatiza kwa kamba zao, lakini sijayasahau mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu waovu wamejaribu kuninasa, lakini sijayasahau mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The word (chevel) is a rope, often of a hunter's snare (18:6; 140:6). It can also mean a band of people.
The verb ('iwwed) is rare; it seems to mean to surround or bind round.
As in 119:1.

alternatives: the ropes of the wicked have wrapped around me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the snare means.

source.text: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [At the] middle of [the] night I rise to give thanks to you for [the] judgments of your righteousness.

en.L: At the middle of the night I rise to give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for the judgments of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.B: In the middle of the night I get up to thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteous rulings.
en.R: In the middle of the night I get up to thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions are right.

fr.L: Au milieu de la nuit je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendre grâce à cause des jugements de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.B: Au milieu de la nuit je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} justes décisions.
fr.R: Au milieu de la nuit, je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes.

sw.L: Katikati ya usiku ninaamka kukushukuru kwa hukumu za haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru kwa hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za haki.
sw.R: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru, kwa sababu hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki.

decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.
As in 119:7.

source.text: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: A companion I [am] of all who fear you, and of those keeping your precepts.

en.L: A companion I [am] of all who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and of those who keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: I stand with all who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, with everyone who holds to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: I am a friend of everyone who honors {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and obeys {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Je [suis] le compagnon de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, et de ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Je suis du côté de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, de tous ceux qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Je suis l’ami de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent et qui obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Mwenzi mimi [ni] wa wote wanaokucha, na wa wale wanaoshika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ninasimama pamoja na wote wanaokucha, pamoja na kila mtu anayeshikamana na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mimi ni rafiki wa kila mtu anayekuheshimu na kuyatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.choice: companion: one who is joined to others
decisions.reason: The word (chaver) is a companion or partner, someone bound to others in a shared life.
To fear God is to honor him with awe and to obey him (34:10).

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.
Readable says "honor", since "fear" alone can sound like terror (m2).

source.text: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [Of] your loyal love, YHWH, is full the earth; teach me your statutes.

en.L: [With] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the earth is full; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love fills all the earth; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love is everywhere on earth. Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [De] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la terre est pleine ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle remplit toute la terre ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est partout sur la terre. Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: [Kwa] upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia imejaa; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unaijaza dunia yote; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma uko kila mahali duniani. Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.choice: the earth is full of his loyal love
decisions.reason: Psalm 33:5 says the same. The stanza ends where it began, with the LORD who fills all things and is the psalmist's portion.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Good you have done with your servant, YHWH, according to your word.

en.L: Good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have treated {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant well, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word said.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been good to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word said.

fr.L: Tu as fait du bien à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bien traité {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole l’avait dit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as été bon pour moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole l’avait dit.

sw.L: Mema umemtendea mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kulingana na neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umemtendea mema mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilivyosema.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa mwema kwangu mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilivyosema.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter teth, the ninth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). Five of them (verses 65, 66, 68, 71, 72) begin with the word "good" (tov), the theme of the stanza.
As in 119:9.

source.text: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Goodness of discernment and knowledge teach me, for in your commands I have believed.

en.L: Good discernment and knowledge teach me, for in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands I have trusted.
en.B: Train me in good sense and knowledge, for I rely on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: Teach me to know what is right and to make wise choices, because I trust {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Enseigne-moi le bon discernement et la connaissance, car j’ai eu confiance en {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Forme-moi au bon sens et à la connaissance, car je compte sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Apprends-moi à savoir ce qui est bien et à faire des choix sages, parce que j’ai confiance en {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Busara njema na maarifa unifundishe, kwa maana katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nimeamini.
sw.B: Unifundishe akili njema na maarifa, kwa maana ninazitegemea amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Unifundishe kujua lililo sawa na kufanya maamuzi ya hekima, kwa sababu ninaziamini amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.reason: The word (ta'am) is taste, and so the ability to tell good from bad (1 Samuel 25:33).
The verb (he'emin) is to hold something as firm and reliable and to lean on it.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Before I was afflicted I was going astray, and now your saying I keep.

en.L: Before I was afflicted I was going astray, but now {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying I keep.
en.B: Until I was brought low, I kept wandering off; but now I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: Before I suffered, I wandered away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. But now I obey what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said.

fr.L: Avant d’être affligé, je m’égarais, mais maintenant je garde {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos.
fr.B: Jusqu’à ce que je sois humilié, je m’écartais sans cesse ; mais maintenant je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Avant de souffrir, je m’éloignais de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Mais maintenant, j’obéis à ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit.

sw.L: Kabla sijateswa nilikuwa nikipotea, lakini sasa kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninaishika.
sw.B: Mpaka niliposhushwa chini, niliendelea kupotea; lakini sasa ninaishika kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Kabla sijateseka, nilipotea mbali na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Lakini sasa ninaitii kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The verb ('anah) is to be bowed down by hardship. Verses 71 and 75 say that God used it to teach the psalmist.

decisions.choice: going astray: straying, often without knowing
decisions.reason: The verb (shagag) is used of wrong done by mistake (Leviticus 4:2).

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: No promise is in view here, so Balanced says "word" and Readable "what you said" (see 119:11).
Readable says from whom the psalmist wandered.

records.literal_gloss: Good [are] you, and doing good; teach me your statutes.

en.L: Good [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and doing good; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: You are good, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring about good; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: You are good, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do good things. Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [Tu es] bon et faisant le bien ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Tu es bon, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais le bien ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Tu es bon, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais de bonnes choses. Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Mwema [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, na mtenda mema; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Wewe ni mwema, na unatenda mema; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Wewe ni mwema, na unatenda mambo mema. Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.choice: doing good: what God always does
decisions.reason: The participle describes what God does by nature: he is good and he does good.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

source.text: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־לֵ֤ב׀אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] arrogant have smeared on me falsehood; I with all [the] heart keep your precepts.

en.L: The arrogant have smeared lies on me; I, with all [the] heart, keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: The proud have plastered lies all over me, but with my whole heart I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: Proud people tell lies to ruin my good name, but I obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions with all my heart.

fr.L: Les orgueilleux ont plaqué sur moi le mensonge ; moi, de tout cœur, je garde {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Les orgueilleux m’ont couvert de mensonges, mais de tout mon cœur je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux disent des mensonges pour salir ma réputation, mais j’obéis à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes de tout mon cœur.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenipaka uongo; mimi kwa moyo wote nayashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi wamenipaka uongo kila mahali, lakini kwa moyo wangu wote ninashikamana na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi husema uongo ili kuliharibu jina langu jema, lakini mimi ninayatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa moyo wangu wote.

decisions.choice: smeared lies on me: covered me with lies
decisions.reason: The verb (tafal) is to smear or plaster over (Job 13:4). Lies are spread over the psalmist to hide who he really is.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

decisions.choice: tell lies to ruin my good name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means.

source.text: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Their heart is unfeeling like fat; I, your instruction I delight in.

en.L: Their heart is gross like fat; as for me, I delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Their hearts are thick and dull as fat, but I delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Their hearts feel nothing, like a lump of fat. But {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching makes me glad.

fr.L: Leur cœur est épais comme la graisse ; moi, je trouve mes délices dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Leur cœur est lourd et insensible comme la graisse, mais moi, je fais mes délices de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Leur cœur ne ressent rien, comme un morceau de graisse. Mais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement me rend heureux.

sw.L: Moyo wao umenenepa kama mafuta; mimi, mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninayafurahia.
sw.B: Mioyo yao ni mizito na butu kama mafuta, lakini mimi ninafurahia mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mioyo yao haihisi kitu, kama donge la mafuta. Lakini mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yananifurahisha.

decisions.choice: unfeeling like fat: dull, closed to God
decisions.reason: A heart covered in fat cannot feel or understand (Isaiah 6:10). The arrogant are set against the psalmist, who delights in God's instruction.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: [It was] good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn your statutes.

en.L: It [was] good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: It did me good to be brought low, so that I would learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: Suffering was good for me, so that I could learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [Il était] bon pour moi que j’aie été affligé, afin que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Il m’a été bon d’être humilié, pour que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Souffrir m’a fait du bien, car ainsi j’ai pu apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: [Ilikuwa] vema kwangu kwamba niliteswa, ili nijifunze kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ilinifaa kushushwa chini, ili nijifunze kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Mateso yalinifaa, ili niweze kujifunza kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.reason: The psalmist does not call suffering good in itself, but says God used it to bring him back to his ways (verse 67; Deuteronomy 8:2-3).

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

records.literal_gloss: Better to me [is the] instruction of your mouth than thousands of gold and silver.

en.L: Better to me [is] the instruction of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth than thousands of gold and silver.
en.B: The instruction {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken is worth more to me than gold and silver by the thousand.
en.R: What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach me is worth more to me than a fortune in gold and silver.

fr.L: Meilleure pour moi [est] la loi de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche que des milliers d’or et d’argent.
fr.B: L’instruction que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcée vaut plus pour moi que l’or et l’argent par milliers.
fr.R: Ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’enseignes a plus de valeur pour moi qu’une fortune en or et en argent.

sw.L: Bora kwangu [ni] mafundisho ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} kuliko maelfu ya dhahabu na fedha.
sw.B: Mafundisho uliyoyanena yana thamani kwangu kuliko dhahabu na fedha kwa maelfu.
sw.R: Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yana thamani zaidi kwangu kuliko mali nyingi ya dhahabu na fedha.

decisions.reason: Hebrew says "good ... more than" to mean "better than". The stanza's word "good" (tov) opens this verse too.
As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: thousands of gold and silver: great wealth
decisions.reason: The phrase means thousands of pieces (weights) of gold and silver (19:11).
Readable says what the amount means.

source.text: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your hands made me and established me; give me understanding, and I will learn your commands.

en.L: Your hands made me and established me; give me understanding, that I may learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: Your hands made me and shaped me; give me insight, so that I can learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: You made me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands and formed me. Help me understand, so that I can learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Tes mains m’ont fait et m’ont affermi ; donne-moi l’intelligence, pour que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Tes mains m’ont fait et m’ont façonné ; donne-moi le discernement, pour que je puisse apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Tu m’as fait de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as formé. Aide-moi à comprendre, pour que je puisse apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilinifanya na kunithibitisha; unipe ufahamu, ili nijifunze amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilinifanya na kunitengeneza; unipe ufahamu, ili niweze kujifunza amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ulinifanya kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} na kuniumba. Unisaidie kuelewa, ili niweze kujifunza amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter yod, the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). The first word, "your hands", begins with it.
The verb (konen) is to set up firmly; of a person, to fashion and make firm (Deuteronomy 32:6).
Job 10:8 uses the same picture: the one who made the psalmist can also teach him.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Those fearing you will see me and rejoice, for for your word I have waited.

en.L: Those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will see me and rejoice, for I have waited for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: Those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be glad when they see me, for I have set my hope on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: People who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be happy when they see me, because I counted on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent me verront et se réjouiront, car j’ai attendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent seront heureux de me voir, car j’ai mis mon espoir dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent seront heureux de me voir, parce que j’ai compté sur {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Wale wanaokucha wataniona na kufurahi, kwa maana nimelingojea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Wale wanaokucha watafurahi wanaponiona, kwa maana nimeliwekea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tumaini langu.
sw.R: Watu wanaokuheshimu watafurahi wanaponiona, kwa sababu nililitegemea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

decisions.choice: will see and rejoice: or a wish, may they see
alternatives: may those who fear you see me and rejoice
decisions.reason: The verbs may state what will happen or express a wish.
As in 119:9.

source.text: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I know, YHWH, that righteousness [are] your judgments, and [in] faithfulness you have afflicted me.

en.L: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments [are] righteousness, and [in] faithfulness {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have afflicted me.
en.B: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings are just, and that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought me low because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I know that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions are right. You made me suffer because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful to me.

fr.L: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements [sont] justice, et [qu’en] fidélité {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as affligé.
fr.B: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes, et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as humilié parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je sais que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes. Tu m’as fait souffrir parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle envers moi.

sw.L: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} [ni] haki, na [kwa] uaminifu umenitesa.
sw.B: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki, na kwamba ulinishusha chini kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninajua kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki. Ulinifanya niteseke kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu kwangu.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness you have afflicted me
decisions.reason: The hardship the psalmist went through was not a sign that God had left him but part of God's faithful care, as a father disciplines a son (Deuteronomy 8:5).
Readable says to whom God is faithful.

records.literal_gloss: Let, please, your loyal love be to comfort me, according to your saying to your servant.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, please, be for my comfort, according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love comfort me, I pray, as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant said.
en.R: Please let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love comfort me, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, said.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, soit pour me consoler, selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle me console, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur l’a dit.
fr.R: S’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle me console, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse me l’a dit, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, tafadhali, uwe faraja yangu, kulingana na kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unifariji, nakuomba, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ilivyosema.
sw.R: Tafadhali upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unifariji, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwangu mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ilivyosema.

decisions.reason: The verb (nicham) is related to the one in verses 52 and 82.

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Let your compassions come to me, that I may live, for your instruction [is] my delight.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion come to me, that I may live, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction [is] my delight.
en.B: Send {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tender mercy to me so that I may live; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction is what I delight in.
en.R: Be kind and gentle with me so that I may live. Your teaching gives me joy.

fr.L: Que viennent sur moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} compassions, pour que je vive, car {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi [est] mes délices.
fr.B: Envoie-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse pour que je vive ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction fait mes délices.
fr.R: Sois doux et bon avec moi, pour que je vive. Ton enseignement me rend heureux.

sw.L: Rehema {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zinijie, ili niishi, kwa maana mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ni] furaha yangu.
sw.B: Uniletee huruma {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nyororo ili niishi; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiyo ninayoyafurahia.
sw.R: Unionee huruma na upole ili niishi. Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yananipa furaha.

decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for the womb: the tender love of a parent (103:13). It is plural, for many acts of mercy.
As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: be kind and gentle with me
alternatives: let your compassion come to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's compassion coming means.

source.text: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] arrogant be put to shame, for [with] falsehood they have wronged me; I, I will meditate on your precepts.

en.L: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for with lies they have wronged me; as for me, I will meditate on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: Let the proud be disgraced, for they have twisted the truth to harm me; but I will ponder {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: Let proud people be put to shame, because they told lies to hurt me. But I will think deeply about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient couverts de honte, les orgueilleux, car par le mensonge ils m’ont fait du tort ; moi, je méditerai sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Que les orgueilleux soient déshonorés, car ils ont tordu la vérité pour me nuire ; mais moi, je méditerai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Que les orgueilleux aient honte, parce qu’ils ont menti pour me faire du mal. Mais moi, je réfléchirai profondément à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi waaibishwe, kwa maana kwa uongo wamenidhulumu; mimi, nitayatafakari maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi waaibike, kwa maana wameupotosha ukweli ili kunidhuru; lakini mimi nitayatafakari maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi waaibishwe, kwa sababu walisema uongo ili kuniumiza. Lakini mimi nitayafikiria sana maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The verb ('iwwet) is to bend or falsify; they have twisted the truth to bring the psalmist down (Job 8:3; Lamentations 3:36).

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

records.literal_gloss: Let those fearing you turn to me, and those knowing your testimonies.

en.L: Let those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turn to me, and those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies.
en.B: Let those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come back to me, those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees.
en.R: Let the people who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come back to me, the ones who know what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: Qu’ils se tournent vers moi, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, et ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages.
fr.B: Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent reviennent vers moi, ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets.
fr.R: Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent reviennent vers moi, ceux qui connaissent ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Wale wanaokucha wanigeukie, na wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Wale wanaokucha warudi kwangu, wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Watu wanaokuheshimu warudi kwangu, wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.choice: and those who know: the form to be read
alternatives: so that they may know your testimonies
decisions.reason: The words follow the form to be read. The written form seems to read "and they will know", making the second line the purpose of the first; the sense is close.

decisions.choice: turn to me: come back to me
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is to turn or return; those who fear God may have drawn back while the psalmist suffered.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.

source.text: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.

en.L: May my heart be blameless in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes, so that I may not be put to shame.
en.B: Let my heart be whole in keeping {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes, so that I will not be disgraced.
en.R: Help me obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws with all my heart, so that I will not be ashamed.

fr.L: Que mon cœur soit intègre dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions, afin que je ne sois pas couvert de honte.
fr.B: Que mon cœur reste entier dans l’observation de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions, pour que je ne sois pas déshonoré.
fr.R: Aide-moi à obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois de tout mon cœur, pour que je n’aie pas honte.

sw.L: Moyo wangu uwe mkamilifu katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ili nisiaibishwe.
sw.B: Moyo wangu uwe mzima katika kuzishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ili nisiaibike.
sw.R: Unisaidie kuzitii kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa moyo wangu wote, ili nisione aibu.

decisions.reason: As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
As in 119:6.

decisions.choice: help me obey ... with all my heart
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wish into a prayer and says what a whole heart means.

records.literal_gloss: My soul is spent for your salvation; for your word I have waited.

en.L: My soul faints for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation; for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word I have waited.
en.B: I am worn out with longing for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rescue; I have set my hope on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: I long so much for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to save me that I have no strength left. Still, I keep hoping in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Mon âme se consume pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut ; j’ai attendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Je m’épuise à désirer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut ; j’ai mis mon espoir dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Je désire tellement que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves que je n’ai plus de force. Pourtant, je continue d’espérer en {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa ajili ya wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} nimelingojea.
sw.B: Nimechoka kwa kuutamani wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; nimeliwekea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tumaini langu.
sw.R: Ninatamani sana uniokoe hata sina nguvu tena. Hata hivyo, ninaendelea kulitumainia neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter kaph, the eleventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). Verses 81-87 are the darkest part of the psalm so far.
The verb (kalah) is to come to an end, to be used up. It comes again in verse 82, and in verse 87 of the enemies who almost made an end of the psalmist.
As in 119:9.
As in the earlier psalms, Literal keeps "soul" (nefesh) and Balanced and Readable say what it means here, the whole person.

source.text: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: My eyes are spent for your saying, saying: when will you comfort me?

en.L: My eyes fail for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying, as I say: when will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me?
en.B: My eyes grow dim as I watch for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise; I keep asking when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will comfort me.
en.R: My eyes are tired from watching for what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised. I keep asking when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will comfort me.

fr.L: Mes yeux se consument pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos, et je dis : « Quand me consoleras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ? »
fr.B: Mes yeux se fatiguent à guetter {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse ; je ne cesse de demander quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consoleras.
fr.R: Mes yeux sont fatigués d’attendre ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as promis. Je demande sans cesse quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vas me consoler.

sw.L: Macho yangu yanafifia kwa ajili ya kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nikisema: utanifariji lini?
sw.B: Macho yangu yanafifia ninapoingojea kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; ninaendelea kuuliza ni lini utanifariji.
sw.R: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa kuingojea kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Ninaendelea kuuliza ni lini utanifariji.

decisions.choice: my eyes fail: I have watched until I can watch no longer
decisions.reason: Eyes that fail are worn out with looking for help that does not come (69:4).

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: The question is the psalmist's own; as elsewhere, his own words are not put in quotation marks.

source.text: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke; your statutes I have not forgotten.

en.L: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes I have not forgotten.
en.B: I am like a skin bottle dried and cracked in the smoke, yet {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes have not slipped my mind.
en.R: I am dried up and useless, like an old leather bottle hanging in smoke. But I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Car je suis devenu comme une outre dans la fumée ; je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Je suis comme une outre desséchée et fendue par la fumée, mais {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions ne sont pas sorties de ma mémoire.
fr.R: Je suis desséché et inutile, comme une vieille gourde en cuir suspendue dans la fumée. Mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimekuwa kama kiriba katika moshi; kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} sijazisahau.
sw.B: Nimekuwa kama kiriba cha ngozi kilichokauka na kupasuka katika moshi, lakini kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} hazijatoka akilini mwangu.
sw.R: Nimekauka na sina faida, kama kiriba cha zamani cha ngozi kilichotundikwa mahali penye moshi. Lakini sijazisahau kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

decisions.choice: a wineskin in smoke: shriveled and useless
decisions.reason: Wine and water were kept in bottles made of animal skin. One hung in the smoke of a fire, in a house without a chimney, would dry out, blacken and crack.
The word (ki) may give the reason for the cry in verse 82, or mean "though", leading to the second line.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: How many [are the] days of your servant? When will you do on [those] pursuing me judgment?

en.L: How many [are] the days of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} execute judgment on those who pursue me?
en.B: How many days does {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant have left? When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge those who hunt me down?
en.R: I do not have long to live. When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring the people who chase me to justice?

fr.L: Combien [sont] les jours de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Quand exerceras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le jugement sur ceux qui me poursuivent ?
fr.B: Combien de jours reste-t-il à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Quand jugeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ceux qui me traquent ?
fr.R: Il ne me reste plus longtemps à vivre. Quand vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} traduire en justice ceux qui me poursuivent ?

sw.L: Siku za mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] ngapi? Utatekeleza lini hukumu juu ya wale wanaonifuatia?
sw.B: Mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} amebakiwa na siku ngapi? Utawahukumu lini wale wanaoniwinda?
sw.R: Sina muda mrefu wa kuishi. Utawahukumu lini watu wanaonifukuza?

decisions.choice: how many are the days of your servant: my life is short
decisions.reason: The question means that the psalmist's life is short and he cannot wait long for God to act (39:5; 89:48).

Here the word (mishpat) is not one of the psalm's words for God's law but its usual sense: God's verdict on those who wrong the psalmist. This is one of the few verses of the psalm with none of the eight words.
The verb (radaf) is to chase someone down, as in verse 86.

decisions.choice: I do not have long to live
alternatives: how many are the days of your servant?
decisions.reason: Readable says what the question means (m1).

source.text: כָּֽרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] arrogant have dug for me pits, which [are] not according to your instruction.

en.L: The arrogant have dug pits for me, which [is] not according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: The proud have dug pits to catch me, people who do not live by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Proud people have dug holes to trap me. They do not follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Les orgueilleux ont creusé pour moi des fosses, ce qui n’[est] pas selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Les orgueilleux ont creusé des fosses pour me prendre, eux qui ne vivent pas selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux ont creusé des trous pour me piéger. Ils ne suivent pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenichimbia mashimo, jambo lisilo kulingana na mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi wamechimba mashimo ili kunikamata, watu wasioishi kwa mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi wamechimba mashimo ili kuninasa. Hawayafuati mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: Hunters dug pits and covered them over to trap animals (7:16; 57:7).

decisions.choice: which: the people, or what they do
decisions.reason: "Which" may refer to the arrogant, who do not live by God's instruction, or to their digging of pits, which his instruction forbids. The sense is the same.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: All your commands [are] faithfulness; [with] falsehood they have pursued me; help me!

en.L: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands [are] faithfulness; with falsehood they have pursued me; help me!
en.B: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands can be trusted; people hunt me down with lies. Help me!
en.R: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands are true and can be trusted. People are chasing me with lies. Help me!

fr.L: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements [sont] fidélité ; par le mensonge ils m’ont poursuivi ; aide-moi !
fr.B: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements sont dignes de confiance ; on me traque avec des mensonges. Aide-moi !
fr.R: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements sont vrais, on peut leur faire confiance. Des gens me poursuivent avec des mensonges. Aide-moi !

sw.L: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote [ni] uaminifu; kwa uongo wamenifuatia; unisaidie!
sw.B: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zinaaminika; watu wananiwinda kwa uongo. Unisaidie!
sw.R: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote ni za kweli na zinaaminika. Watu wananifukuza kwa uongo. Unisaidie!

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.
As in 119:30: God's commands are steady and true.

decisions.choice: with falsehood: with lies, without cause
decisions.reason: The word (sheqer) is the one in verse 29; the psalmist is hunted by lies and for no reason.

source.text: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Almost they have made an end of me on the earth, but I, I have not forsaken your precepts.

en.L: Almost they have made an end of me on the earth, but as for me, I have not forsaken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: They came close to finishing me off in the land, yet I have not let go of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: They almost killed me, but I have not turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Ils ont failli m’anéantir sur la terre, mais moi, je n’ai pas abandonné {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Ils ont été près d’en finir avec moi dans le pays, mais je n’ai pas lâché {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Ils ont presque réussi à me tuer, mais je ne me suis pas détourné de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Karibu wamenimaliza duniani, lakini mimi sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Walikaribia kunimaliza kabisa katika nchi, lakini sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Walikaribia kuniua, lakini sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

decisions.reason: The verb is the one in verses 81-82 (kalah), here "finish off".
The word ('erets) can mean the whole earth or the land.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

records.literal_gloss: According to your loyal love give me life, and I will keep [the] testimony of your mouth.

en.L: According to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love give me life, and I will keep the testimony of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth.
en.B: Keep me alive in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, and I will hold to the decree {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.
en.R: Keep me alive because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, and I will obey what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: Selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal fais-moi vivre, et je garderai le témoignage de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche.
fr.B: Garde-moi en vie dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, et je m’attacherai au décret que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcé.
fr.R: Garde-moi en vie à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, et j’obéirai à ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Kulingana na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unihuishe, nami nitaushika ushuhuda wa kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}.
sw.B: Unihuishe katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, nami nitaushika ushuhuda ulioutamka.
sw.R: Uniweke hai kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, nami nitautii ushuhuda ulioutamka.

decisions.choice: give me life: keep me alive, renew my life
testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2; here the word is singular ('edut).
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Forever, YHWH, your word [is] standing firm in the heavens.

en.L: Forever, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word [is] standing firm in the heavens.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word lasts forever; it is fixed in place in the heavens.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word lasts forever. It is set firmly in heaven, where nothing can shake it.

fr.L: Pour toujours, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole [se tient] ferme dans les cieux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole dure pour toujours ; elle est fixée dans les cieux.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole dure pour toujours. Elle est établie solidement dans le ciel, où rien ne peut l’ébranler.

sw.L: Milele, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [limesimama] imara mbinguni.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linadumu milele; limewekwa imara mbinguni.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linadumu milele. Limesimikwa imara mbinguni, mahali ambapo hakuna kitu kinachoweza kulitikisa.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter lamed, the twelfth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).

decisions.choice: standing firm: set in place, stationed
decisions.reason: The verb (nitsav) is used of something set up to stand, like a pillar or a guard at his post. God's word is as fixed as the heavens where he reigns (verses 90-91).
The word (davar) is the broadest of the psalm's eight terms for what God has made known: anything he has spoken, whether command or promise.
Readable spells out what it means for the word to stand firm in heaven.

source.text: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: To generation and generation [is] your faithfulness; you established [the] earth, and it stands.

en.L: To generation and generation [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} established the earth, and it stands.
en.B: Your faithfulness lasts from one generation to the next; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set the earth in its place, and it remains.
en.R: You stay faithful to people in every age. You made the earth firm, and it is still standing.

fr.L: De génération en génération [est] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as établi la terre, et elle tient.
fr.B: Ta fidélité dure d’une génération à l’autre ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mis la terre à sa place, et elle demeure.
fr.R: Tu restes fidèle aux gens de toutes les époques. Tu as rendu la terre solide, et elle tient encore.

sw.L: Kizazi hata kizazi [ni] uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; uliiweka imara dunia, nayo inasimama.
sw.B: Uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unadumu kizazi hadi kizazi; uliiweka dunia mahali pake, nayo inadumu.
sw.R: Unabaki mwaminifu kwa watu wa kila kizazi. Uliifanya dunia imara, nayo bado imesimama.

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: through all generations
decisions.reason: The doubled word means every generation in turn, without end.

decisions.choice: it stands: it endures, it stays in place
decisions.reason: The verb ('amad) is to stand. The earth God set up has not fallen; verse 91 uses the same verb of all creation.

source.text: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: By your judgments they stand this day, for everything [are] your servants.

en.L: By {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments they stand this day, for all things [are] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants.
en.B: They stand today by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings, since all things are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants.
en.R: Heaven and earth are still here today because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions. Everything there is serves {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Par {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements ils se tiennent aujourd’hui, car toutes choses [sont] {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} esclaves.
fr.B: Ils subsistent aujourd’hui selon {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions, car toutes choses sont à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} service.
fr.R: Le ciel et la terre sont encore là aujourd’hui grâce à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions. Tout ce qui existe {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sert.

sw.L: Kwa hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} vinasimama leo, kwa maana vyote [ni] watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Vinasimama leo kwa hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, kwa kuwa vitu vyote ni watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.R: Mbingu na dunia bado zipo leo kwa sababu ya hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Kila kitu kilichopo kinakutumikia.

decisions.choice: they: the heavens and the earth
alternatives: they stand (ready) today for your rulings
decisions.reason: "They" are most likely the heavens and the earth of verses 89-90, which stand because God has ruled that they should (compare Jeremiah 33:25). The words can also mean that they stand ready, like servants, waiting for his rulings.
The word (mishpatim) is the decision of a judge. Here it is what God has ruled to be right, which he also carries out. Here they are the rulings by which God orders creation.
As throughout the psalm, Literal keeps "judgments", Balanced says "rulings" and Readable "decisions", so that the sense of a judge's verdict is not lost.
Everything God made does his will; nothing in creation is his rival (104:4).
Readable names what "they" refers to (m1).

alternatives: "tes serviteurs" at Literal, as the English
decisions.reason: Literal says "esclave" for 'eved, as it does wherever the word is not the psalmist's "ton serviteur"; the point is that all creation is at God's disposal. Balanced and Readable say it with "service" and "servir", which read naturally of things.

source.text: לוּלֵ֣י ת֭וֹרָתְךָ שַׁעֲשֻׁעָ֑י אָ֝֗ז אָבַ֥דְתִּי בְעָנְיִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: If not your instruction [had been] my delight, then I [would have] perished in my affliction.

en.L: If {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction [had] not [been] my delight, then I [would have] perished in my affliction.
en.B: Had I not taken delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction, I would have died in my trouble.
en.R: If I had not loved {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching so much, my suffering would have killed me.

fr.L: Si {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi n’[avait] pas [été] mes délices, alors j’[aurais] péri dans mon affliction.
fr.B: Si je n’avais pas fait mes délices de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction, je serais mort dans ma détresse.
fr.R: Si je n’avais pas tant aimé {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement, ma souffrance m’aurait tué.

sw.L: Kama mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [yasingalikuwa] furaha yangu, ndipo ningaliangamia katika mateso yangu.
sw.B: Kama nisingalifurahia mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, ningalikufa katika taabu yangu.
sw.R: Kama nisingalipenda mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sana, mateso yangu yangaliniua.

decisions.reason: The word (torah) is teaching or direction, from a verb meaning to point the way. In this psalm it is God's whole teaching for his people, not only a set of rules.
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "teaching" for torah.

decisions.choice: delight: joy, what one plays and delights in
decisions.reason: The word (sha'ashu'im) is plural, "delights": the deepest pleasure (verses 24, 77, 143, 174).
The word ('oni) is misery and humiliation, often at the hands of others.

source.text: לְ֭עוֹלָם לֹא־אֶשְׁכַּ֣ח פִּקּוּדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֥י בָ֝֗ם חִיִּיתָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: Forever I will not forget your precepts, for by them you have given me life.

en.L: Forever I will not forget {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts, for by them {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given me life.
en.B: Never will I forget {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts, for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have used them to give me life.
en.R: I will always remember {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions, because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have used them to keep me alive.

fr.L: Pour toujours je n’oublierai pas {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes, car par eux {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as fait vivre.
fr.B: Jamais je n’oublierai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes, car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en es servi pour me donner la vie.
fr.R: Je me souviendrai toujours de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en es servi pour me garder en vie.

sw.L: Milele sitayasahau maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa maana kwa hayo umenihuisha.
sw.B: Sitayasahau kamwe maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, kwa maana umeyatumia kunihuisha.
sw.R: Nitayakumbuka maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} siku zote, kwa sababu umeyatumia kuniweka hai.

decisions.reason: "Forever I will not forget" is a strong way of saying "I will never forget".
The word (piqqudim) comes from a verb meaning to appoint or put in charge. It occurs only in the Psalms, for the particular charges God has given his people.
Readable uses a plainer word, as throughout the psalm.

decisions.choice: give me life: keep me alive, renew my life

records.literal_gloss: To you I [belong]; save me, for your precepts I have sought.

en.L: Yours [am] I; save me, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts I have sought.
en.B: I belong to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}; save me, for I have searched out {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: I am {{deity_pronoun:yours|Yours}}, so save me! I have tried hard to follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Je [suis] à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} ; sauve-moi, car j’ai recherché {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}appartiens ; sauve-moi, car j’ai cherché à connaître {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Je suis à {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, alors sauve-moi ! J’ai fait tous mes efforts pour suivre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Wako mimi [ni]; uniokoe, kwa maana maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nimeyatafuta.
sw.B: Mimi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; uniokoe, kwa maana nimeyatafuta maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mimi ni {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, basi uniokoe! Nimejitahidi sana kuyafuata maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
